entries.title: IRIS: Reconstructing signaling histories of single cells via perturbation screens and transfer learning
entries.inspection: Article abstract, Results, methods/data availability and source-data listings.
entries.supports: Transferable signaling signatures and history inference.
entries.limits: Inverse inference does not establish arbitrary forward cell dynamics or physical rates.

entries.title: IRIS current GEO data records
entries.inspection: Series metadata, processed-file listings and annotated barcode-map documentation; archives not downloaded.
entries.supports: GSE289836 maps hM_d4; GSE327767 maps hM_d7/hE_d8; Step 3 -1 denotes not applied.
entries.limits: Well/condition identity, feature-build inconsistency and raw-to-processed mapping need authentication before ingestion.

entries.title: IRIS author reproduction repository
entries.inspection: README, data documentation, private derived-file path references and MIT code license.
entries.limits: Stale accession mapping and unbundled derived objects/checkpoints; no local build or training attempted; code license does not establish dataset terms.

entries.title: Hypoxia induces ROS-resistant memory upon reoxygenation in vivo promoting metastasis in part via MUC1-C
entries.inspection: Primary indexed Results/Discussion and data availability; some direct requests failed.
entries.supports: Persistent post-hypoxic response in specific experimental systems.
entries.limits: Context, selection and co-occurring stress limit mechanism and transfer claims.

entries.title: GSE240211 bulk RNA-seq metadata
entries.inspection: All five listed sample conditions, reoxygenation sample metadata and processed-file listing; expression matrices not read.
entries.supports: A small descriptive bulk-expression contrast dataset.
entries.limits: No independent replicate IDs or age-matched day-20 normoxic control exposed; inadequate alone for independent memory validation; deposited-data license not established.

entries.title: Growth and adaptation mechanisms of tumour spheroids with time-dependent oxygen availability
entries.inspection: Primary Results, figures, experimental methods and data availability.
entries.supports: Oxygen-perturbation study with radial endpoint observables.
entries.limits: Destructive radial endpoints are not individual longitudinal trajectories; explicit growth/observation model needed; paper does not validate this runtime.

entries.title: Murphy author data and processing code
entries.inspection: Three XLSX files fetched and parsed in memory with urllib, zipfile and ElementTree; headers/nonempty rows inspected; MATLAB loader and exclusion routine read, not executed.
entries.supports: Small endpoint tables and inspectable author filtering.
entries.limits: Row counts are not independent replicate counts; specimen/batch keys and terms unresolved; no standalone repository license found; no files persisted or fitted.

entries.title: Systema
entries.inspection: Indexed primary abstract/Main/results; direct article request failed.
entries.supports: Systematic effects can confound genetic-perturbation metrics; relevant simple controls.
entries.limits: Methodological lesson applied to our design, not an oxygen-response experimental finding.

entries.title: BATCHIE
entries.inspection: Primary methods/results and actual model/scoring interfaces.
entries.supports: Batch active experimental design and separation of predictions, noise, candidates and scores.
entries.limits: Drug-screen setting; neither imported nor a ready molar-uptake adapter.

entries.title: Reinforcement Learning from Contrastive Distillation
entries.inspection: Original method and language-alignment evaluation scope.
entries.supports: Prompt-generated preference pairs and language-model RL.
entries.limits: Prompt polarity supplies no independent biological labels; externally scored preferences would change the method.

entries.title: PRAXIS-VirtualCell
entries.inspection: Abstract and PDF contracts/adapters/evidence, comparisons and future state extensions.
entries.limits: Not reproduced; architecture overlap does not establish biological predictive validity.

entries.title: Model and experiment standards
entries.inspection: Official overviews and PEtab version/features documentation.
entries.limits: No format adapter or conformance test executed; choose an exercised version/subset before claiming interoperability.

entries.title: XiaomiMiMo verl fork
entries.inspection: Commit diff, recipe/runner/actor/reward interfaces, settings, package metadata and selected test source; nothing executed.
entries.limits: Token IDs/masks/log-probs are LLM interfaces; numeric cell trainer requires another adapter/backend. Multi-GPU examples are not minimum requirements or local benchmarks.

entries.title: MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss dataset
entries.inspection: Pinned card/tree, current Viewer metadata and small task examples; selected manifest/rubric/verifier read, never executed.
entries.supports: Task assets, separate graders, reward detail and failure records.
entries.limits: Five agent-task families; no cell-model training task verified. Viewer counts are live metadata, not revision-bound; sizes exclude environments/images. Card declares Apache-2.0; embedded assets not individually audited.

entries.title: CellTRIP
entries.inspection: Indexed primary abstract and repository description/training interface; direct full paper fetch failed.
entries.supports: Closest located precedent for interacting virtual cells learned with multi-agent RL.
entries.limits: Full methods/benchmark reproduction not audited; no local training, numerical equivalence or tumor-response validation established.

entries.title: CellFluxRL
entries.inspection: Problem/data formulation, rewards and RL method.
entries.supports: Reward-based post-training of image-based cell-response generation.
entries.limits: Unpaired image distributions; reward scores do not establish conservative tissue dynamics or independent biological validation.

entries.title: Hierarchical deep reinforcement learning reveals a modular mechanism of cell movement
entries.inspection: Publisher and indexed primary Results/methods; PMC direct request challenged.
entries.supports: Cell-level RL within a measured developmental environment and subsequent examination of inferred cell organization.
entries.limits: Scoped migration study, not general cellular response or cancer-therapy validation.
